name: CMDO reviewer re-execution contract v1
purpose: Define what a portable reviewer may regenerate from executable code and what must be verified as frozen derived evidence because of prospective sealing, restricted data, or historical lineage.
portable_claim: A fresh GitHub clone can verify all tracked final inputs, run the deterministic reconstructed synthetic stress replay, and regenerate Figure 1-5 plus Extended Data Figure 1-2 without author-machine files.
not_claimed: A generic reviewer computer can re-run every historical prospective stage from raw patient-level data.

stages.reason: sealed prospective lineage; canonical outputs are the evidentiary object used by the final figures
sealed sentinel reserve; no generic automatic rerun
sealed independent reserve; final figures consume canonical outputs
sealed deployment evaluation; final figures consume canonical outputs
NHANES is public, but the stage is sealed and its v1.1 rerun is explicitly disclosed rather than silently folded into the generic reviewer command
eICU patient-level data require authorized access; a public GitHub clone cannot redistribute or universally regenerate those raw-data analyses
locked external ECG prospective verdict and post-completion diagnostics are preserved as tracked final records
protocol-locked information-closure witness is consumed as a tracked final result record
fully synthetic deterministic reconstruction; replay is an audit of the design and is intentionally separated from the frozen manuscript Figure-5 source
all final renderer inputs are repository-relative and SHA-256 verifiable
